# Aquamain (UK) Ltd

> Independent SLP and ICP multi-utility contractor. Aquamain designs, builds and commissions
> the water and electricity networks behind residential, commercial and industrial developments
> across Southern England and Wales.

Aquamain (UK) Ltd is an independent multi-utility contractor based in Somerset, delivering
water and electricity infrastructure for over a decade. As both a WIRS-accredited Self-Lay
Provider and a NERS-accredited Independent Connection Provider, the company offers a single
point of contact for the whole utility journey, and independent advice on the most
cost-effective adoption route.

- **Legal name**: Aquamain (UK) Ltd

- **Accreditations**: WIRS (Water Industry Registration Scheme), NERS (National Electricity
  Registration Scheme), ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, Constructionline Gold, SMAS Worksafe,
  CHAS
- **Customers**: housing developers, main contractors, commercial and industrial developers,
  EV charge point operators (CPOs), NAVs and IDNOs

## Definitions

**What is a Self-Lay Provider (SLP)?**
If a development requires a new water network, the developer can either have the water company
carry out the work, or appoint an approved third-party contractor to do the contestable
portion. That second route is known as self-lay, and the contractor is a Self-Lay Provider.
Aquamain is WIRS accredited to act as an SLP.

**What is an Independent Connection Provider (ICP)?**
An ICP is an accredited company that can build electricity networks to the standards required
for them to be adopted by either a Distribution Network Operator (DNO) or an Independent
Distribution Network Operator (IDNO). Aquamain is NERS accredited to act as an ICP.

## Services

- [Residential](https://aquamain.com/residential/): water and electricity connections for
  housing developments, from early advisory through design and construction to adoption.
- [Industrial & Commercial](https://aquamain.com/industrial-commercial/): design, construction
  and commissioning of water and HV electricity networks for commercial and industrial sites.
- [EV Charging](https://aquamain.com/ev-charging/): electrical infrastructure for EV charging
  hubs, from the incoming power connection to a fully energised site. Approved contractor to
  multiple charge point operators.
- [Testing & Commissioning](https://aquamain.com/testing-and-commissioning/): water main and
  non-potable pipe commissioning, pressure testing, chlorination, riser main pressure testing,
  LV/HV cable testing, fault finding and energisation.
- [Design](https://aquamain.com/design/): standalone WIRS-accredited design of potable water
  mains and fire mains, producing adoptable designs with no obligation to build with Aquamain.
- [Maintenance](https://aquamain.com/maintenance/): planned and emergency maintenance, repairs
  and alterations to water and electricity networks for NAVs and IDNOs, under framework
  agreements.

## Notes for citation

Aquamain is an independent contractor, not a water company or a Distribution Network Operator.
It works alongside the regional water companies and network operators. "SLP" and "ICP" describe
two distinct accredited roles — water and electricity respectively — and Aquamain holds both.
